integration.note: Integrated into DEDL from the original Singapore Promotions and Cards brief. No separate deployed site or reusable repository was located.

offers.name: DBS/POSB: S$288 welcome cashback
offers.benefit: Apply by 31 October using CASH288; approval by 14 November. Spend S$800 within 60 days of approval. Cashback is credited 3–5 months after meeting the spend requirement.
offers.eligibility: For applicants with no principal DBS/POSB credit card and none cancelled in the past 12 months. Maintain a valid PayLah! account by the spend-period end. One gift per person; cannot combine with other sign-up offers. Instalments, wallet top-ups, utilities, insurance, tax and other listed transactions are excluded. Account must remain eligible through fulfilment.

offers.name: OCBC 365 / NXT: S$300 welcome cashback
offers.benefit: S$300 cashback after S$800 qualifying spend within 60 days of approval (approval date is Day 1). Apply by 31 December 2026.
offers.eligibility: New principal cardmembers with no OCBC credit card held in the previous 12 months. Apply directly via OCBC website, app or branch; approval within 30 days. Third-party applications excluded. One welcome gift; keep the card 12 months to avoid clawback. Insurance, wallet top-ups, fees and specified MCCs excluded; full terms control.

offers.name: OCBC INFINITY: 16% welcome cashback
offers.benefit: 1.6% base plus 14.4% bonus on the first S$2,000 qualifying spend within 60 days of approval. Bonus capped at S$288; no minimum spend. Apply by 31 December 2026.
offers.eligibility: Same direct-application and new-cardmember requirements as OCBC’s S$300 offer, including a 12-month lookback and 12-month card-retention condition. One welcome gift across the promotion. Bonus-spend exclusions apply; see the dated OCBC terms.

offers.name: Citi Cash Back+: 8% welcome cashback
offers.benefit: 1.6% base plus 6.4% bonus on up to S$4,000 qualifying spend; bonus capped at S$256 (S$320 total on S$4,000). Minimum S$800 qualifying spend. Apply by 31 March 2027.
offers.eligibility: Online applicants only: no existing principal Citi credit card, none closed in the past 12 months, and no pending principal-card application. Approval within 30 days. The PDF defines the spend window as the opening month plus the next two calendar months (its example: 12 August–31 October), rather than 60 days. Bonus credited within three months after that window. Fees, instalments, bill payments and other exclusions apply; no stacking with acquisition offers unless stated.

corrections.change: Rechecked the official FX promotion PDF: end date now 31 December 2027, resolving the previously recorded 2026 PDF discrepancy. Australia rate changes to 0.5% from 1 January 2027. No other card/offer recertification implied.

offers.name: UOB EVOL: up to 1% cashback on foreign-currency spend
offers.benefit: 0.5% cashback on eligible FX spend processed in China and defined European countries; 1% on other eligible FX spend. From 1 January 2027, Australia receives 0.5%. No minimum spend or cashback cap under the linked promotion terms.
offers.eligibility: Singapore-issued EVOL card; payment must be processed outside Singapore in foreign currency. Overseas SGD transactions do not qualify. Shell/SPC, wallet top-ups, cash advances, fees, instalments and listed MCCs are excluded. The linked PDF now extends through 31 December 2027; country, processing and transaction exclusions control.

cards.name: DBS yuu Card
cards.audience: Ages 21–75. SG/PR: S$30,000/year up to age 55; S$15,000 from 56. Foreigners: S$45,000/year.
cards.reward: Up to 18% at participating merchants, awarded as yuu Points redeemable for rebates. 5% at eligible participating merchants without the S$800 threshold; 0.25% base on non-yuu spend.
cards.min_spend: S$800 eligible spend and transactions at four participating merchant groups per calendar month for the extra 13%.
cards.cap: Combined bonus rewards: 28,800 yuu Points = up to S$144/month; base rewards uncapped.
cards.annual_fee: Principal S$196.20 incl. GST; first year waived.
cards.exclusions: Link yuu account and scan/link yuu ID where required. Merchant/product exclusions apply; Charge+ bonus excludes Amex. Wallet top-ups, insurance, utilities, tax and specified MCCs excluded. Reward points are not cash deposited to a bank account.

cards.name: UOB EVOL Card
cards.audience: SG/PR: S$30,000/year up to 55; S$15,000 from 56. Foreigners: S$40,000/year. Secured-card route from S$10,000 fixed deposit, subject to bank terms.
cards.reward: 10% on eligible local online/mobile-wallet contactless and selected gym/telco/streaming spend; 0.3% other eligible local spend. Separate FX promotion above. No FX administrative fee on qualifying foreign-currency spend.
cards.min_spend: S$800 per statement month for local 10% categories; otherwise 0.3%.
cards.cap: S$80 local cashback/month: S$20 selected gym/telco/streaming, S$30 online/contactless combined, S$30 other spend.
cards.exclusions: Shell/SPC, wallet top-ups, utilities, insurance, tax and listed MCCs excluded. Physical-card tap is not mobile-wallet contactless. Overseas SGD transactions retain a 1% international processing fee.

cards.name: OCBC 365 Credit Card
cards.audience: SG/PR: income S$30,000/year at ages 21–55; S$15,000 above 55. Foreigners: S$45,000/year. Issuer approval applies.
cards.reward: Through 31 October: 6% petrol, 5% eligible dining, 3% groceries/land transport/selected recurring bills/streaming/EV charging/Watsons; otherwise 0.25%. From 1 November: 6% dining/groceries/land transport/petrol; most recurring-bill categories fall to 0.25% (see issuer’s change notice).
cards.min_spend: Through 31 October: S$800 or S$1,600/calendar month. From 1 November: single S$800 tier.
cards.cap: Through 31 October: S$80 at S$800 spend; S$160 at S$1,600. From 1 November: S$160 at S$800.
cards.annual_fee: S$196.20 incl. GST; first two years waived. Subsequent automatic waiver at S$10,000 eligible annual spend.
cards.exclusions: MCC/merchant rules apply. Fees, tax, cash advances, insurance, wallet top-ups, AXS/SAM and listed transactions excluded. October hotel dining/banquets earn base only. Read both dated term sets on the issuer page.

cards.name: OCBC INFINITY Cashback Card
cards.audience: SG/PR: income S$30,000/year at ages 21–55; S$15,000 above 55. Foreigners: S$45,000/year. Issuer approval applies.
cards.reward: 1.6% on eligible local/overseas retail spend; automatically credited. Welcome bonus listed separately above.
cards.annual_fee: S$196.20 incl. GST; first year waived. Subsequent automatic waiver at S$10,000 eligible annual spend.
cards.exclusions: Insurance, utilities, education, government/tax, wallet top-ups, AXS/SAM, fees, instalments and specified MCCs excluded. Foreign-currency fees can exceed cashback; see issuer’s fee schedule.

cards.name: Citi Cash Back+ Card
cards.audience: SG/PR: S$30,000/year. Foreigners: S$42,000/year. Subject to issuer approval.
cards.reward: 1.6% on eligible retail purchases. Mastercard holders with qualifying Citi Plus / Interest Booster arrangements may earn 0.4% extra; welcome bonus listed separately.
cards.min_spend: None for base. Citi Plus bonus: S$500 eligible retail spend/calendar month.
cards.cap: Base uncapped; 0.4% bonus capped at S$8/month (S$2,000 eligible spend).
cards.annual_fee: Principal S$196.20 incl. 9% GST; any waiver subject to issuer terms.
cards.exclusions: Fees, cash/quasi-cash, transfers, bill payments, insurance, government, education and other listed MCCs excluded. Base cashback does not expire; redemption via Citi Mobile/SMS. Check the separate bonus terms before counting the additional 0.4%.
